items.headline: CoreWeave sweetens terms on $2.6B loan tied to Anthropic, Jane Street and Hudson River Trading capacity as investors balk at AI debt; CoreWeave's 5-year CDS up over 50% this month
items.note: A neocloud having to widen pricing (+up to 125bps) and deepen the discount (99c to 97c) to clear a loan is a direct market read on deteriorating AI-debt appetite, not commentary.

items.headline: Meta's free cash flow collapses 91% YoY to $784M as AI investment consumes 98% of operating cash flow; shares fall ~9% on a disappointing revenue outlook
items.note: Near-total consumption of operating cash by AI capex is a credit-relevant cash-generation signal distinct from the stock move itself, and raises the odds Meta leans further on debt to fund its build-out.

items.headline: Alphabet raises 2026 capex guidance to as much as $205B and posts its first negative free cash flow since its 2004 IPO; shares fall ~7%
items.note: A hyperscaler burning cash for the first time in its public history while raising capex guidance above analyst expectations sharpens the question of how the AI buildout gets financed if internally generated cash no longer covers it.
